item.title: U.S. Refueling Plane Crashes in Iraq, Military Says
item.summary: The incident was not a result of hostile or friendly fire, according to U.S. Central Command. President Trump lifted sanctions on Russia to increase the oil supply. American officials say Iran is mining the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran’s Frantic Attempt to Save Its Ships Before Torpedo Attack
item.summary: The Iranian Navy sought refuge in Sri Lanka and India. While India obliged, Sri Lanka stalled over fears it would threaten its neutrality.

item.title: Ground Down by War, Hezbollah’s Loyal Base Shows Cracks
item.summary: “We just want to be back in our homes,” said a Lebanese man who, like many others in the latest round of fighting, has to flee.

item.title: Trump’s Iran War Is Causing Problems For His Ally in Italy, Giorgia Meloni
item.summary: War in the Middle East has left Italy’s prime minister in a domestic bind, presenting her with one of the biggest challenges of a previously stable tenure.

item.title: 15 Are Sentenced to Life for Moscow Concert Hall Massacre
item.summary: At least 149 people died in the 2024 terror attack outside the Russian capital, for which the Islamic State claimed responsibility.

item.title: Iran’s Retaliatory Strikes Appear to Be Slowing
item.summary: U.S. officials say the country’s weapons have been diminished, slowing its attacks on Gulf nations and Israel. Iran may also be holding some weapons in reserve in case the conflict is prolonged.

item.title: A Visit to a Temple at the Heart of the Thailand-Cambodia Conflict
item.summary: A rare visit to a Khmer temple on Thailand and Cambodia’s border showed how deadly clashes between the two countries have scarred a heritage site.

item.title: How the War in Iran Could Help China and Change Asia
item.summary: American officials have said for years that they would prioritize the Indo-Pacific. Now they’re moving warships, missiles and air defenses out for a war in the Middle East.

item.title: How Russia’s Scorched-Earth Attacks Put Ukraine’s Power Grid Near Collapse
item.summary: Strikes on Ukrainian energy systems have tripled this winter. Continuous repairs and Western aid staved off a total breakdown.

item.title: Israel Drops Case Against Soldiers Accused of Abusing Palestinian Detainee
item.summary: After a prisoner arrived at a hospital with broken ribs and a torn rectum, Israelis were once again at odds over the issue of mistreatment and impunity.
